resources.string: Make meyouww work like WhatsApp when it\'s closed.
This phone will stop getting notifications until you sign in again.
When meyouww is closed, messages and wallpapers still arrive within seconds, as long as these are set up. It takes about a minute.
Push is set up in this build
This build has no Firebase settings, so nothing can arrive while the app is closed. Install a build made with the settings in docs/SETUP.md.
Notifications are off for meyouww or for an important category. Every remote change is announced, so they must be on.
Android lets meyouww run when needed.
Battery use is set to \"Restricted\", which blocks background work. Open App info → Battery and choose \"Unrestricted\" or \"Optimised\".
Downloads can run on mobile data.
Data Saver blocks background downloads. Allow unrestricted data for meyouww.
%1$s phones can stop apps after you swipe them away. Allow meyouww once, then confirm below.
Google Play services is missing or needs an update. Without it, nothing can arrive while meyouww is closed.
Alarms and reminders can ring on time.
Without this, alarms and reminders may ring a few minutes late. It doesn\'t affect messages.
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → meyouww → turn on Autostart. Then Battery saver → No restrictions.
Settings → Apps → App management → meyouww → Battery usage → allow background activity and auto launch.
Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → meyouww → Allow. Also allow Autostart in i Manager.
Settings → Battery → App launch → meyouww → Manage manually, and turn on all three switches.
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → make sure meyouww is not in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps.
Phone Master → App management → Auto-start → allow meyouww. Also set Battery to No restrictions.
Open App info → Battery and allow background activity. dontkillmyapp.com has steps for your exact phone.
Tap the button, then swipe meyouww away from your recent apps and lock your phone. A test arrives in about 20 seconds.
Asking the server to send a test
Test on its way. Swipe meyouww away and lock your phone now.
The test hasn\'t arrived yet. Check the items marked ✗ or ? above, then try again.
Allow notifications first. The test shows up as a notification.
What happened to the last notifications on this phone, newest first. It holds no names, messages or IDs, and stays on this phone unless you copy it.
Nothing yet. It fills in as messages arrive.

Like WhatsApp, meyouww can\'t receive anything after you use \"Force stop\" (until you open it again), while your phone is off or offline, or on phones without Google Play services. Accepted alarms still ring offline.

Friends you allow to see your screen specs get previews that match your phone. These answers help them too.
A picture from a friend would replace it, and meyouww can\'t bring a live wallpaper back.
My lock screen rotates its own pictures
Some phone makers\' lock screens may cover a lock-screen wallpaper.
Share my phone\'s maker and model
Only with friends who can see your screen specs. Off by default.

A favourite picture of your own. If you ever want your phone back to normal, “Restore my wallpaper” puts it on. Android doesn\'t let apps read your current wallpaper, so meyouww can only restore what it has.
Asking the server what it knows about this phone…
✗ This phone isn\'t registered for notifications
The server doesn\'t know this phone yet, so it has nowhere to send notifications. Tap below to register it.
✗ Google Play services gave no notification token
Notifications come through Google Play services. Update it, check that it isn\'t disabled, then come back here.
✗ The server doesn\'t have this phone\'s notification token
Your phone has a token but it never reached the server. Tap below to send it again.
✗ The server\'s notification sender isn\'t connected
This is fixed on the meyouww server, not on your phone. Until then, open the app to see new things in your inbox.
✗ Firebase refused the server\'s notification key
This is fixed on the meyouww server (its Firebase key), not on your phone.
✗ This phone\'s token belongs to a different Firebase project
The app and the server use different Firebase projects. This is fixed on the meyouww server, not on your phone.
Tap below to get a fresh one and send it to the server.
✓ The server is sending your notifications
Google accepted every recent notification for you. If they still don\'t show up, the cause is on this phone: check the items above, especially the phone maker\'s autostart and battery settings.
✓ Ready. Nothing has been sent to you yet
Ask a friend to send you something, or use the test below.
This report stays on your phone. Copy it and send it to whoever helps you with meyouww; it only has code locations, no messages or photos.
You can change your name and your ID once every 15 days. Your ID is how friends find you, and nobody else can have the same one.
3 to 20 letters, numbers, dots or underscores, starting with a letter
Saved. Your friends will see the new one.
Someone already has that ID. Try another one.
That ID is not available. Try another one.
You changed it less than 15 days ago. Try again once 15 days have passed.
Too many tries. Wait a little and try again.
Check the name and the ID: the ID needs 3 to 20 letters, numbers, dots or underscores and must start with a letter.
That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
Your chats are kept on this phone, end-to-end encrypted. The server deletes its encrypted copy as soon as it arrives. To delete a chat, open it and tap ⋯ → Clear chat on this phone.
Messages vanish from this phone after they\'ve been seen and you leave the chat, unless you save them. Only affects this phone.
